notes.title: Update 1.01 Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello! got a small Bugfix Update for you all! 

Fixed a bug where the game would call an unloaded Foe and grant you a large amount of score for no reason. 
Fixed a bug where a hitbox for the outer screen was visible during the cornelius boss fight
Fixed a bug where you could fly over the UI in some stages. 
Added New logo on game boot-up 
Changed How to play text to tell the player that they can hold down the shoot button. 

Thanks for playing- Joe
